skill_name: Name five fashion trends that were popular in 2020
workflow: Five popular fashion trends in 2020 were oversized silhouettes, vintage-style pieces, bright and bold colors, sustainable fashion, and athleisure wear. Oversized silhouettes featured relaxed, free-flowing shapes for a comfortable and effortless look. Vintage-style pieces included classic patterns and plenty of denim.
